value.kbd_note: Presentation Manager Desktop Manager; drive it from an OS/2 Command Prompt window for a clean echo test.
value.note: 1024x768x65536-color (16bpp) accelerated Cirrus desktop; requires /opt/qemu-cirrusfix. PS/2 relative mouse is driven through daemon abs coordinates with edge re-homing and calibrated cursor_scale.

labctl.notes: PS/2 RELATIVE pointer only — -machine isapc has no USB, so usb-tablet and every absolute route are unavailable. No exec channel and no network at all (OS/2 1.3 ships no TCP/IP stack): use `labctl sh` (blind) or the framebuffer.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# os213 (VMID 203) — IBM OS/2 1.30.2 Standard Edition, Presentation Manager.
#   *** TCG ONLY *** -machine isapc -cpu 486 -m 16. OS/2 1.x predates PCI: a
#   pc-i440fx machine freezes this guest at SeaBIOS "Booting from Hard Disk...",
#   and -m 8 froze there too (both raced 2026-09-13, see docs/lab/OS213-WAVE.md).
# DISK: -device ide-hd with AUTO geometry. Never pin CHS — `-drive ...,cyls=` is
#   rejected by QEMU 11 outright, and pinning the source image's 310/16/63 on the
#   ide-hd made the boot worse. FAT, under the OS/2 1.3 504 MB CHS ceiling.
# DISPLAY: -device isa-vga; PM runs VGA 640x480x16.
# POINTER: QEMU PS/2 RELATIVE. isapc has NO USB, so usb-tablet and every absolute
#   route are unavailable; this is the machine's only transport, not a shortcut.
# NETWORK: none. OS/2 1.3 ships no TCP/IP stack, so os213 is off the retronet and
#   has no rn-tapnet.sh (rule 15).

museum.blurb: The last operating system IBM and Microsoft shipped together — Presentation Manager on a 16-bit protected-mode kernel, six months after Windows 3.0 ended the partnership.
museum.notes: Microsoft OS/2 1.30.1 under the fleet QEMU on an ISA i486 (-machine isapc) with 16 MB, VGA 640x480x16 and a PS/2 relative mouse, accelerated with KVM. No network: OS/2 1.3 has no bundled TCP/IP stack, so retronet is OPEN. Archetype: beige-ibm-pc.
museum.periodBrowser: none — 1990, and OS/2 1.3 has no bundled TCP/IP stack; IBM TCP/IP for OS/2 was a separate product

emulator.source: pve-qemu-kvm 11.0.2-1 (host package); stock qemu-system-i386 with KVM. TCG is a WRONG answer for this guest: under -accel tcg OS/2 1.3 traps just after the boot banner on two independently produced systems.
